messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: cvodes plans...
parts:
Hi!

So we are going to bring in CVODES into Stan as far as I understood. To go forward I will

1. open issues on stan and cmdstan (rstan?)
2. start the branches by bringing the built system in line with CVODES
3. as I have never changed the language I can only try to figure that out (introduce integrate_ode_cvodes + variants)

Now assuming that my CVODES branch is already good enough to be quickly included into Stan (still awaiting a code review), it would potentially make sense to consider it for v2.10 already. Doing so would have the advantage of

1. Being able to remove the integrate_ode_cvode function now, i.e. we would not have to carry around a deprecated function
2. We only have to deal with changeing libraries once for the interfaces
3. Very likely more happy ODE users (certainly my models will run *much* faster)

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] cvodes plans...
parts:
On Friday, April 8, 2016 at 10:59:02 AM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
Re: windows... we didn't have enough test coverage on Windows and I missed that CVODE stopped building on Windows.

So did I. Did something change recently? It was working a few days ago.

Regarding CVODES, there is a somewhat outdated R package

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/Rsundials/index.html

that has pretty much nothing in its Makevars file and it builds successfully everywhere, so I think it should not be too much trouble to build it ourselves. But we have to make it a static library on !Windows, like we did with CVODE.

Ben
